source: Derived from the SunSpec Alliance information models (https://github.com/sunspec/models, json/model_<id>.json, commit 90b4a331dcca1d6eac69c1bead952fddcc5852e0, Apache License 2.0): point names, offsets, types, sizes, scale factors, units, access and symbol values only. Offsets count from the first register after the model's ID and L. Modified: the symbol names of model 111's St are written without the stray "gg" prefix the source has, as in models 101 to 113.
